    SELECT order_id, SUM(amount) AS total_discount
    FROM order_discounts

    FROM order_shipments

)

    m.merchant_name,

tasks.name: Clickstream Sessionization with Inactivity Gaps
tasks.reason: All correctness and performance checks passed
tasks.candidate_sql:
WITH lagged AS (
    SELECT
        event_id,
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS prev_timestamp
    FROM user_events
),
session_boundaries AS (
    SELECT
        event_id,
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        CASE
            WHEN prev_timestamp IS NULL
              OR event_timestamp - prev_timestamp > INTERVAL 30 MINUTE
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_session_start
    FROM lagged
),
session_numbered AS (
    SELECT
        event_id,
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        SUM(is_session_start) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM session_boundaries
)
SELECT
    user_id                  AS user_id,
    session_id::BIGINT       AS session_id,
    MIN(event_timestamp)     AS session_start,
    MAX(event_timestamp)     AS session_end,
    COUNT(*)::BIGINT         AS event_count
FROM session_numbered
GROUP BY user_id, session_id
ORDER BY user_id ASC, session_start ASC;
tasks.golden_sql:
WITH lagged AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        CASE
            WHEN event_timestamp - LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (
                PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp
            ) > INTERVAL 30 MINUTE 
                 OR LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (
                PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp
            ) IS NULL THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_new_session
    FROM user_events
),
session_indexed AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        CAST(SUM(is_new_session) OVER (
            PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS BIGINT) AS session_id
    FROM lagged
)
SELECT
    user_id,
    session_id,
    MIN(event_timestamp) AS session_start,
    MAX(event_timestamp) AS session_end,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM session_indexed
GROUP BY user_id, session_id
ORDER BY user_id ASC, session_start ASC;
